description.value: Pinewoods Restaurant is the main dining room at Manning Park Resort, a major year-round destination sitting directly on Highway 3 in BC's Cascade Mountains — one of the key routes for cyclists doing the Hope-Princeton corridor. Described on the resort website as 'Comfort Food Meets Mountain Ambience,' it shares the resort complex with Bear's Den Pub, lodge accommodations, and campgrounds, making it a genuine full-service stop in an otherwise remote stretch of highway. The restaurant is open daily and part of a resort that draws over one million visitors annually.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 32m; rack (10 spaces) at 87m; rack (8 spaces) at 96m. Total: 21 spaces.

The contact page provides the physical address (7500 HWY #3, Manning Park, BC) and phone (1-604-668-5922) absent from OSM tags. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Pinewoods Restaurant is a confirmed, actively operating full-service restaurant on Highway 3 at Manning Park Resort — a well-known landmark stop for cyclists on the Hope-Princeton route with no comparable food services for many kilometres in either direction.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort also operates Bear's Den Pub (open daily 3pm–9pm per hours page), which may warrant a separate OSM record if one does not already exist. Country Store on-site may also be relevant for cyclists seeking supplies.
